name: slaughterfest_v0-2
author: Unity Play
description:
Imported some other assets to understand how animation and attack trigger work etc. 

For enemy placement I wrote a RNG script based on the item spawner that can spawn any prefab n times with random radius and angle into the world and attached it to one enemy. That one then serves as the spawning center => more enemies, less manual work for me :)

I did not figure out in time how to build an end trigger so instead I added a "hidden" final area to hack and slash around. 

Finally to get below 100MB to be able to upload, I also learned how to reduce texture size => 512x512px for many textures. I overshot my target and am around 58 MB now.

You may have to kite a few enemies to stay alive and the boss is a bit harder to hit. Try to taunt him around!

Feedback is very welcome!

Features:
- quick intro by in-game books
- more enemy types (various skeletons,Arthur)
- full equipment slots with prefabs
- color coded paths
- additional easter egg weapon
- SlaughterFarm unlock after endboss
